paper.title: Algorithm 776: SRRIT, a Fortran subroutine to calculate the dominant invariant subspace of a nonsymmetric matrix (ACM TOMS 23(4), 1997)

field: numerics (dominant invariant subspace and eigenvalues of a nonsymmetric matrix, subspace iteration with Ritz refinement)
stack: Fortran 77 (netlib TOMS 776.gz: shell archive with Doc/, Drivers/Dp, Drivers/Sp, Src/Dp, Src/Sp; the double-precision driver and routines are Drivers/Dp/driver.f and Src/Dp/dsrrit.f, dblas.f, dlapack.f)

claim.text: WR, first converged real eigenvalue, of the BWM problem (test matrix size 200, after 2000 SRRIT iterations) printed by the authors' double-precision driver, registered as -1235.506919564 (tol_abs 1e-6). Revised by scout in 9e8879b from the earlier RWK 496 location, which prints 1.0 first; the value is in the BWM block.

values.name: WR, first converged eigenvalue, BWM 200x200 (double precision)

attempt: Original attempt (G1): the authors' documented build (Doc/Makefile, epcf90) fails because epcf90 is not installed (make exit 2). Build-only patch (compiler substitution, no source edit): the authors' double-precision driver and routines are compiled unmodified with gfortran 16 -O2 and linked; tools/verify_sources.py records 9 files compared, none modified, no added files. The run prints WR = -1.235506919564D+03 as the first converged eigenvalue of the BWM block (test matrix size 200), which equals the registered -1235.506919564 at every printed digit (|diff| below 1e-12). The RWK block (size 496) prints 1.000000000000D+00 first, as the earlier note said. Two passes gave the same BWM value: the 08:40Z wake and this wake (08:47Z). Build-only, so no paper check (G2 na).

original_attempt.reason: The authors' documented make target calls epcf90, which is not installed in the sandbox (make: epcf90: No such file or directory). The authors' own compiler is not available to this plant.

build_commands: gfortran -O2 driver.o dsrrit.o dblas.o dlapack.o -o dsubspiter
